progression.trend_rule: Trends compare the last 14 days (today included) with the 28 days before. Each side needs at least 3 sessions with the metric, else 'not enough data'. 'flat' means the change is under: 10% for weekly volume, 2% for pace, half a grade for grade averages, 10 percentage points for send rate. Volumes are weekly averages; for volume, 'improving' just means more.
